full_text:
🔥 ‘THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING’ IS TRACKING FOR A HUGE OPENING!

Ticket pre-sales are reportedly through the roof, with the film now eyeing a $120M–$150M domestic opening weekend!

If it reaches those numbers, it could become Lionsgate's biggest domestic opening in 14 years! 👀

Did you expect the new ‘HUNGER GAMES’ movie to open this big?
